advancements.oreganized.demoted.descript: Use lead bolts in a crossbow to strip a pillager of his Ominous Banner
advancements.oreganized.demoted.title: Demoted
oreganized.ponder.blow_lead_cloud.text_1: Placing Raw Lead or Lead ore in the path of a fan creates a dust cloud
You can melt a lead block in a cauldron by heating it up with a campfire
You can then take out the molten lead using a bucket
oreganized.ponder.heat_transfer.text_1: Lead blocks heat up when touching a hot block
oreganized.ponder.heat_transfer.text_2: Removing the heat source will cause them to cool down again
oreganized.ponder.lead_mining.text_1: Mining lead ore causes lead dust clouds to be released
oreganized.ponder.lead_mining.text_2: Lead ore that is touching water will not create any dust clouds
